title: Loja: Trocas e Devoluções
subtitle: Retail · returning a product at a store in Portuguese

sentences.en: Hello, I would like to return this shirt.
sentences.target: Olá, eu gostaria de devolver esta camisa.

sentences.en: Of course. Do you have the receipt?
What is the problem with the shirt?
sentences.target: Qual é o problema com a camisa?

sentences.en: It is too small for me.
Would you like a different size or your money back?
sentences.target: Você quer um tamanho diferente ou o dinheiro de volta?

sentences.en: I would like a larger size, please.
sentences.target: Eu quero um tamanho maior, por favor.

sentences.en: We have a medium and a large in stock.
sentences.target: Temos médio e grande em estoque.

sentences.en: I will take the large one.
